title: The Bloodthirsty Bride Devours the King Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
A website opened on Monday to announce that a television anime of writer Shiki and artist Yū Shinonome's The Bloodthirsty Bride Devours the King (Chi ni Ueta Hanayome wa Ō o Kurau) manga will air next year.

The "forbidden dark romantic fantasy" is set in an era of war. Kate, a princess maiden with vampiric powers, enters an arranged marriage with Luka, the mightiest king of the realm, to protect her motherland. However, on their first night, the scent of his blood awakens her true nature, which shakes their bond to the core. Is the destined couple's bond merely a contract, instincts, or love?

Mariko Iwazaki is directing the anime at IMAGICA Infos and Imageworks Studio , and Shiki is personally writing the scripts. The company en-dolphin is producing the project. Taeko Miura is directing the sound at the studio RD , and Kujira Yumemi ( As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill , Chillin' in Another World With Level 2 Super Cheat Powers ) is composing the music. Kazuya Takahashi is credited with production supervision.

The original manga has been available in individual chapters or volumes on various Japanese digital services including honto, and the 29th chapter and fourth volume debuted in October.
author: ANN

title: My Lovesick Life as a '90s Otaku's Nico Nicholson Launches New Manga
content:
Kodansha 's Be Love magazine announced on Friday Nico Nicholson will launch a new manga titled Yosojito Konkatsu in the next issue on December 1.

The magazine teases the series with the tagline: "I was fine with living alone, however — the search for something before the 'however' begins!"

Nicholson ended the My Lovesick Life as a '90s Otaku ( Inishie Otaku no Koiwazurai ) manga in Kodansha 's Kiss magazine in February 2023. Kodansha shipped the fourth and final volume in May 2023. Kodansha USA publishes the manga in English and shipped the fourth volume in August 2024.

title: New Resident Evil Reboot Film Earns US$400 Million Globally
content:
According to Box Office Mojo, the film has earned US$399,998,502 globally: US$157,398,502 in the United States and US$242,600,000 internationally.

The film ranked at #7 in the U.S. last weekend, earning an estimated US$2,525,000 from Friday to Sunday.

According to Variety, the film is now the highest-grossing installment in the live-action horror franchise.

The film opened in the United States on September 18. The film ranked at #1 and earned an estimated US$60 million in its opening weekend in the U.S.

The film opened in Japan on October 9, and ranked at #2 in its opening weekend.

The film stars Austin Abrams ( Weapons , Euphoria , Wolfs ) as Bryan. The cast also includes Zach Cherry , Kali Reis , and Paul Walter Hauser ( Richard Jewell , Black Bird , The Fantastic Four: First Steps ).

Zach Cregger ( Barbarian , Weapons ) directed the new film. Constantin Film and PlayStation Productions produced the new reboot film. Shay Hatten ( John Wick: Chapter 4 , Zack Snyder's Army of the Dead ) co-wrote the screenplay along with Cregger. Constantin's Robert Kulzer , Vertigo Entertainment 's Roy Lee ( Minecraft ), Miri Yoon ( Woman of the Hour ), and PlayStation Productions produced the movie, and Nicole Brown oversaw it. Dariusz Wolski was the director of photography.

This film is the eighth live-action film in the franchise.

title: Voltage, Toei Animation Reveal Kakan Ruirui: The Caged Lantern of Yomi Otome Game For Release in 2027 on Switch
content:
Game developer Voltage announced on Monday it and Toei Animation are developing the Kakan Ruirui: The Caged Lantern of Yomi (Kakan Ruirui: Urayomi Terasu Hōzukiyo) otome game for a scheduled digital release on Nintendo Switch in 2027. Voltage is releasing the game as part of its console brand AmuLit.

The "Japanese-inspired dark fantasy" game will have language support in Japanese and in English. The game's tagline is "It all begins with a life lost."

The game will feature illustrations by Yone Kazuki ( Hakuōki ). Ririka Yoshimura ( Neon Clash -Echoes of the Lost-, Cupid Parasite ) is writing the scenario, Naohiro Yūki ( Arknights: RISE FROM EMBER ) is the background artist, and Yamato ( The Red Bell's Lament ) from Heart Company is composing the soundtrack. Arika will perform the game's theme song. Yoshimura and Voltage 's Rei Misaki are directing the game. Producers include Voltage 's Satoshi Nohara and Toei 's Hiroaki Shibata and Honoka Kishi .

The Animate Girls Festival 2026 event being held in Ikebukuro on November 7 and 8 will reveal the first teaser video. Visitors to the booth will receive a booklet featuring character information and a large promotional shopping bag.

AmuLit stated it will reveal the main characters on November 7 at 12:00 p.m. JST (November 6 at 10:00 p.m. EST).

Voltage 's other console games as part of its AmuLit brand include: even if TEMPEST, even if TEMPEST: Dawning Connections, The Red Bell's Lament, Neon Clash -Echoes of the Lost- , and sins of KALEIDO .

title: Toshihiro Nagoshi's Nagoshi Studio Shuts Down
content:
NetEase Games had announced the formation of Nagoshi Studio Inc. in January 2022. The studio announced its first game Gang of Dragon during The Game Awards in December 2025.

Bloomberg then reported in March 2026 that a NetEase spokesperson confirmed it will stop financing the studio. According to that report, NetEase decided to stop funding the studio after it discovered the game would need additional funding of 7 billion yen (about US$44 million) to be completed.

Nagoshi Studio producer Daisuke Satō had in June listed himself as an "ex-Nagoshi Studio" employee across his social media accounts.

Nagoshi stepped down from his role as chief creative officer of Sega in April 2021, but continued at the company as creative director. Nagoshi then left Sega in October 2021. He had been working for Sega since 1989.

In September 2024 Bloomberg reported that NetEase had laid off most of the staff at Ouka Studios ( Visions of Mana ) in Tokyo and intended to shut down the studio's offices in Shibuya (the studio closed in late 2024). NetEase had hired former staff from companies such as CAPCOM , Bandai Namco, and Square Enix when establishing console-focused teams at Ouka in Shibuya in 2020. Visions of Mana developer Ryosuke Yoshida then joined Square Enix in December 2024.

title: Tomoo Performs Ending Theme for Hirayasumi TV Anime
content:
The anime will premiere in January 2027 in Japan on the NHK General channel. Viz Media also announced an English release in 2027.

The anime stars :

• Yūma Uchida as Hiroto Ikuta

• Mayu Takahashi as Natsumi Kobayashi

• Rikako Aikawa as Hanae Wada

• Daisuke Namikawa as Hideki Noguchi

• Yōko Hikasa as Yomogi Tachibana

• Yume Miyamoto as Akari Yokoyama

• Yūichirō Umehara as Ryō Ishikawa

• Japanese television announcer Yūko Naitō as Narrator

Kei Suezawa ( Fate/Grand Order The Movie Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot - Wandering: Agateram , FLCL Progressive ) is directing the anime at Production +h. Naoyuki Asano (2022 Urusei Yatsura , Keep Your Hands Off Eizouken! , Mr. Osomatsu ) is designing the characters. Mika Nishimura ( Dead Dead Demon's Dededede Destruction , Typhoon Noruda ) is the art director. Kaori Sawada ( What Did You Eat Yesterday? , When Spring Comes ) is composing the music.

Viz Media and Japan Society hosted the world premiere screening of the first episode at Japan Society's location in New York City on October 7.

Viz describes the human drama story:

With a carefree outlook on life, Hiroto knows better than anyone that slowing down is sometimes the best way to move forward. At 29 years old, carefree Hiroto Ikuta doesn't have a girlfriend, a full-time job, or a plan for the future—and he couldn't be happier. Hiroto's breezy attitude isn't easy for everyone to understand, though. In a world filled with anxiety, confusion, and grief, Hiroto and the people who surround him are all just doing their best to figure out this thing called life. After developing an unlikely friendship with the grouchy old woman who lives in his neighborhood, Hiroto suddenly finds himself inheriting not just her house but some rather difficult emotions as well. His 18-year-old cousin, Natsumi, moves in with him, but as a struggling art student, she has her own troubles to deal with and may just put Hiroto's easygoing lifestyle to the test.

Shinzō launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine in April 2021. Shogakukan published the manga's 10th compiled book volume on April 30, and the series has over 1.1 million copies in circulation worldwide. The manga will end on November 16.

The manga was nominated for the 15th Manga Taisho awards in January 2022, ranked #18 in the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook in December 2022, was nominated for the 27th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in February 2023, and was nominated for Best Continuing Manga Series in the 2nd American Manga Awards.

The manga also inspired a live-action series , which premiered on NHK in November 2025.

Denpa has licensed Shinzō's Holiday Junction collection of short manga. The book contains seven one-shot manga. Shogakukan shipped the book in Japan in July 2016.

title: Claymore's Norihiro Yagi Launches Bartlet Fairy Basslet Manga
content:
Norihiro Yagi launched a new manga titled BARTLET FAIRY BASSLET on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ service on Monday. Shueisha will publish the second chapter on November 9.

MANGA Plus began publishing the manga in English on the same day, and it describes the story:

After defeating her nemesis, Knight-Captain and Princess Brunhilde sees a mysterious shining fish fall from the sky... From the creator of Claymore comes a new hack and slash fantasy epic!

Viz Media 's Shonen Jump service is also publishing the manga in English.

Yagi debuted his Claymore manga in 2001 and ended the series in 2014. Viz Media released the 27-volume series in North America. The manga inspired a television anime adaptation in 2007, and Funimation released the anime on home video.

Yagi's Angel Densetsu manga ran from 1993 to 2000, and Shueisha published 15 compiled book volumes. The series inspired an original video anime in 1996.

Yagi's Sōkyū no Ariadne ( Ariadne in the Blue Sky ) manga launched in Shogakukan 's Weekly Shonen Sunday magazine in December 2017, and ended in February 2023. The manga has 22 volumes.

title: Opera Manga Magazine Announces Shift to Digital Publication
content:
The editorial department for Akaneshinsha 's Opera magazine announced on X (formerly Twitter ) the magazine will switch to a digital format following the release of its 100th and final print issue on Friday. The first digital-only issue will launch in spring 2027.

The commemorative 100th issue looks back on the history of the magazine and includes work from 40 past contributors illustrating the futures of their characters. A special 100th issue exhibition will be held in Tokyo from December 26 - January 24.

The magazine launched in December 2005. Notable series published in the magazine in the past include Asumiko Nakamura 's Classmates ; Syundei 's Go for It, Nakamura! ; and its sequel Go for It Again, Nakamura! .

title: 2026 Today's Korean Comics Awards Announce 5 Winners
content:
The Korea Cartoonist Association and South Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MCST) announced the five winners of the 2026 “Today's Korean Comics” awards on October 20. The winning works are:

• A Ghost Story in Wartime by Tae-jin Kang

• Osaka Loop Line by Hyeona Hyeon

• Low Orbit Human by Eun-young Cho

• The Journey of Ice and Steel by Uolon

• Tyranno Noh Kyung-Soo by Hiphop Sinsun

All five winning works are serialized on Naver WEBTOON . A selection committee comprising industry professionals, creators, and reader representatives chose the winners from 15 nominated works. The committee was established in May.

Among the winners, Low Orbit Human also received the Korea Cartoonist Association President's Award, selected from the 15 finalists.

First established in 1999, Today's Korean Comics is one of South Korea's three major comic awards, alongside the Bucheon Manhwa Awards and the Korea Content Awards. Each of the five winners receives the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism Award and a cash prize of 7 million won (approximately US$5,000).

The awards ceremony will take place on November 3 during the annual Comics Day celebration.

While four of the winners are not available in English, fans can read The Journey of Ice and Steel on WEBTOON . The webtoon has been serialized in English since June.
